sang.definition:
n North American woodland herb similar to and used as substitute for the Chinese ginseng
v deliver by singing

sanger.definition:
n. English biochemist who determined the sequence of amino acids in insulin and who invented a technique to determine the genetic sequence of an organism (born in 1918)
n. United States nurse who campaigned for birth control and planned parenthood; she challenged Gregory Pincus to develop a birth control pill (1883-1966)
